name: Cadillac V-16 Roadster 1930
description:
1930 Cadillac V-16 (Series 452) roadster, Fleetwood style 4302: 105 built, the least expensive of the Sixteens at $5,350. 452 cu in 45-degree overhead-valve V16 with hydraulic valve silencers: 175 bhp at 3400 rpm, 320 lb-ft at 1400 and over 300 from idle. Three-speed Synchro-Mesh gearbox, 4.39 axle, vacuum-assisted mechanical 16.5 in drums, beam axles on semi-elliptic springs, 148 in wheelbase, 5325 lb. Six wire wheels with twin side-mounts, trunk rack, Pilot-Ray driving lamps.

3D model: "1930 Cadillac V-16 Roadster" by Kryox Shade (https://sketchfab.com/kryoxshade), CC BY 4.0 - https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/1930-cadillac-v-16-roadster-5eee6450ffb145438b3cf548d0795dc0 - modified by Street Corsa Mods.
Port, rework, physics, sound, gauges, steering wheel and skins: Street Corsa Mods - https://streetcorsamods.com/
Driver pose, animations and collider box: Kunos Simulazioni.
This mod is open to anybody who wants to improve it: https://sourceforge.net/p/streetcorsa-mods/cadillac-v16-roadster-1930/
author: Street Corsa Mods
